dataset.name: Maharashtra crop recommendation prototype
dataset.intended_scope: Prototype that predicts the recommended-crop label supplied in this file for inputs from the five represented districts. This is not independently validated, field-level agronomic advice.
dataset.target_definition: Crop is the dataset's supplied recommended-crop label. The model learns to predict that label; it does not establish that the crop is optimal or predict crop success, yield, or profit.

columns.name: fertilizer
columns.reason: A fertiliser choice is downstream of crop selection and may leak the target. Keep it only for future, agronomist-reviewed advisory work.

columns.name: reference_link
columns.reason: Reference links are untrusted content metadata and are directly target-correlated in this dataset. They must never be model features.

production_blockers: Source provenance and licence are not recorded.
There is no season, date, year, plot identifier, or geospatial coordinate.
There is no yield, profit, irrigation, crop-history, or verified farmer outcome.
Measurement units and collection methodology are unconfirmed.
